title.en: The One With the Signed Photos

description.es: Andrés conversa con Marta sobre su relación con Valentina y su miedo de no poder olvidar a Begoña, como ella no puede olvidar a Fina. Al hojear un periódico, que Pelayo obtuvo de México, Marta descubre unas fotografías firmadas con S.V., lo que la hace pensar de inmediato en Fina. Pelayo, nervioso, observa cómo Marta se convence de que puede encontrarla a través de las fotos.
description.en: Andrés talks with Marta about his relationship with Valentina and his fear of never being able to forget Begoña, just as she cannot forget Fina. While leafing through a newspaper that Pelayo brought back from Mexico, Marta discovers some photographs signed "S.V.", which immediately makes her think of Fina. A nervous Pelayo watches as Marta becomes convinced that she can find her through the photos.
